description: BLASTPol was the polarimetric Balloon-borne Large Aperture Submillimeter Telescope, mapping linearly polarised dust in molecular clouds from a stratospheric balloon.
facility_description: BLASTPol flew from Antarctica, including a December 2012 flight.
notes: The paper centres the wavebands at 250, 350 and 500 microns. NJM's keys are 1200GHz, 600GHz and 850GHz. Those numbers were not printed on the opened abstract, so no per-band Description was attached. bibcode:2016PhDT.......113G was not opened. No requested acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.
